Don Wolff has become one of the leading authorities of jazz on film. A lawyer by trade, his love of jazz has led to a weekly radio show for KMOX that covers most of the country every Saturday. Don has amassed one of the largest collections of jazz on film in the U.S. He is a frequent guest at festivals and jazz parties where he shares his film clips and considerable knowledge about jazz personalities and the history of this American art form.
Don was interviewed by Monk Rowe at the Sarasota Jazz Festival on April 13,
